[TERMS AND CONDITIONS]
 Welcome to Overseer, an application made to maintain a healthy digital lifestyle!
 The following contents will introduce to you the Terms and Conditions that you are encouraged to read through and accept before you start using the application. Please read through them carefully.

 Our goal is to provide our users with an analysis of their screen time data, including, but not limited to distribution between mobile apps and average time spent during a daily and weekly time frame. We believe that this app will steer our users in the right direction towards responsible use of technology, and consequently encourage them to promote healthy habits associated with the subject of mental wellbeing.

 By using this application, you agree to the following terms and conditions:

 [USE OF SERVICE]

 - The user will be asked to enable specific permissions in order to access and subsequently gather the data needed from their devices. By granting these said permissions, the user consents to the permission of the purposes outlined in these Terms and Conditions.

 - The user agrees to use the application strictly for personal matters, and will not be permitted to reverse-engineer, exploit, or tamper with the functions of the app.

 [USER DATA PRIVACY]
 In accordance with Republic Act No. 10173 or the Data Privacy Act of 2012, Overseer is obliged to protect the user's personal data and treat it with utmost respect and confidentiality. This law ensures that all of the user's gathered information will be collected, examined, stored, and used responsibly and securely.
 The user has the right to access their data being used in the application; they may inquire about the purposes, handling, and use of their data.
 The user is made aware that personal data that concerns sensitive information will NOT be used NOR collected by the application.
 The user is provided the option to withdraw at any time by uninstalling the application.
 The user has the right to request the deletion of their personal data once it is no longer necessary for the purposes for its collection, or if the user withdraws their consent.

 [DATA SHARING AND THIRD PARTIES]
 Our application, Overseer, collects and gives a complete analysis of the user's screen time data. The data collected by the app is used solely to provide answers to our ongoing research, as well as ideas about your screen time habits and to support your journey toward healthier technology usage. We are committed to protecting your privacy. Under no circumstances do we sell, trade, or rent your personal data, and we do not integrate it with any third-party software, nor do we share your data with it.

 [RETENTION OF DATA]
 We value your privacy and are dedicated to maintaining the confidentiality of your data. Our application collects data regarding your time of use of mobile devices and provides analysis.
 Your data will only be retained as long as necessary to deliver these services and improve user experience. Once the data is no longer required for these purposes, it will be securely deleted.

 [CHANGES TO PRIVACY & POLICY]
 We reserve the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy as needed to reflect changes in our practices, legal requirements, or improvements in our services. Any updates will be communicated to you through the app, and the revised policy will include an updated "Last Modified" date.

 [AGREEMENT TO TERMS AND CONDITIONS]

 By downloading and using Overseer, you confirm that you have read, understood and will consent to be bound by these Terms and Conditions. If you disagree with any of these terms, you must discontinue the use of this application and uninstall it from your selected device.
